in_marathi.name: Subhranshu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhranshu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has a bright, shining intellect and shows courage in the face of adversity, maintaining loyalty to his beliefs.
